name: Windows LLMNR Disabled
description:
Ensures Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution is disabled by policy (EnableMulticast = 0). LLMNR responses are easily spoofed to capture NTLM hashes.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): LEA agent account must be allowed to run only: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient" /v EnableMulticast (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

remedy.command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient" /v EnableMulticast /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null; reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient" /v EnableMulticast
